title: Delete or wire up the unreachable form.error branch in reward_configuration_screen.dart
why: RewardForm.error defaults to null and is never set to a non-null value anywhere: RewardConfigController.bootstrap() explicitly sets `error: null`, and grep across the whole gamification feature finds no other `copyWith(error: ...)` call. The `if (form.error != null)` branch and its whole error Scaffold (lines 287-293) are therefore unreachable dead code -- a maintenance trap for the next person who assumes it's live error-handling.
recommendation: Either delete the dead branch, or wire a real failure path (e.g. bootstrap()'s try/catch setting a localized error) that actually reaches it.
acceptance_criteria: Either the form.error != null branch is removed, or a test demonstrates a real code path setting it and rendering the error Scaffold

corrections: Rule tag "AG-6 hygiene" is loose (AG-6 is literally about TODO markers/commented code, not dead branches); digest's separate "dead code" sweep item is the better citation. Doesn't affect validity.
